words.definition: n. 小地毯；厚毛毯

examples.en: A Persian rug covers most of the living-room floor.
examples.zh: 一块波斯地毯铺满了客厅大半地面。

examples.en: He pulled the rug from under his partner by quitting suddenly.
examples.zh: 他突然辞职，拆了合伙人的台。

words.usage: 指可移动的小块地毯，整屋满铺用 carpet；习语 pull the rug from under sb 突然撤回支持，使某人陷入困境。派生：rugged adj. 崎岖的、粗犷的。
collocations: pull the rug out 突然撤回支持
words.mnemonic: rug 小毯、mug 大杯、tug 拖拽：-ug 三兄弟

words.definition: n. 散文；平淡乏味的行文

examples.en: Her prose is clear, precise, and free of jargon.
examples.zh: 她的散文清晰准确，没有术语堆砌。

examples.en: The anthology includes both prose and verse from the period.
examples.zh: 该选集收录了那一时期的散文与韵文。

words.usage: 不可数名词，指与韵文 verse 相对的散文、白话文；in prose 以散文体写作。派生：prosaic adj. 平淡乏味的，此引申义是考研阅读高频考点。
collocations: prose and poetry 散文与诗歌
purple prose 华而不实的文风
write in prose 以散文体写作
words.mnemonic: pro(向前)+se → 平铺直叙向前讲 → 散文

words.definition: n. （有柄的）壶，罐；一罐的量

examples.en: The waiter brought a jug of iced water for each table.
examples.zh: 服务员给每桌端来一壶冰水。

examples.en: She poured milk from a ceramic jug into the pan.
examples.zh: 她用陶瓷奶罐把牛奶倒进锅里。

words.usage: 英式英语指有柄有嘴的水壶、奶罐，a jug of water 一壶水；美式还可指大酒罐。量词 jugful 一罐之量。近义 pitcher 多用于美式，flask 指保温瓶。
collocations: a jug of water 一壶水
a jug of cream 一罐奶油
words.mnemonic: jug 有柄大水罐；mug 杯、rug 毯，-ug 串记

words.definition: n. 住处，住宅（正式用词）

examples.en: The valley contains dwellings that date back to the Bronze Age.
examples.zh: 该河谷分布着可追溯到青铜时代的居所。

examples.en: Traditional cave dwellings keep warm in winter and cool in summer.
examples.zh: 传统窑洞冬暖夏凉。

words.usage: 正式用词，指住所、住宅，法律与社会文本高频；常见 dwelling place 连用。动词 dwell on、upon 老是想着、喋喋不休，为考研重点短语；dweller n. 居民。
words.mnemonic: dwell(住) → 心里「住」着事 → dwell on 纠结

words.definition: n. 房东；地主；（英）酒馆老板

examples.en: The landlord promised to repair the leaking roof before winter.
examples.zh: 房东答应在入冬前修好漏水的屋顶。

examples.en: Rents rose sharply as landlords took advantage of the housing shortage.
examples.zh: 房东们利用房荒大幅涨租。

words.usage: 可数名词，女房东称 landlady；租务搭配 landlord and tenant 房东与租客，合同文本常见。pub landlord 英式指酒馆老板。派生：landlordism n. 地主制度。
collocations: landlord and tenant 房东与租客
words.mnemonic: land(地)+lord(主) → 地之领主 → 房东、地主

words.definition: n. 女仆，女佣；（古）少女

examples.en: The hotel maid changes the towels twice a day.
examples.zh: 酒店客房服务员每天两次更换毛巾。

examples.en: In the novel, a maid secretly keeps her mistress's letters.
examples.zh: 小说中，女仆偷偷保存着女主人的信件。

words.usage: 可数名词，指女仆、女佣；maid of honor 美式首席伴娘；old maid 为「老姑娘」贬称。派生：maiden n. 少女，adj. 首次的，如 maiden flight 首航。
collocations: hotel maid 酒店客房服务员
words.mnemonic: m+aid(帮) → 上门帮忙的女子 → 女仆；同音 made

words.definition: n. 郊区，近郊（常用复数）

examples.en: They moved to a suburb where housing was more affordable.
examples.zh: 他们搬到了住房更便宜的郊区。

examples.en: Commuter trains link the outer suburbs with the city center.
examples.zh: 通勤列车把远郊与市中心连接起来。

words.usage: 常用复数 the suburbs 指「郊区一带」，in the suburbs of a city 在某市郊区。派生：suburban adj. 郊区的，引申「平庸乏味的」；suburbanite n. 郊区居民。
collocations: the suburbs of Beijing 北京郊区
words.mnemonic: sub(近,次)+urb(城) → 紧贴城市 → 郊区

words.definition: n. 草坪，草地；上等细麻布

examples.en: He spends every Sunday mowing the lawn in the garden.
examples.zh: 他每个周日都在花园里修剪草坪。

examples.en: The children played badminton on the lawn behind the house.
examples.zh: 孩子们在屋后草坪上打羽毛球。

words.usage: 可数名词，指修剪整齐的草坪；mow the lawn 修草坪、lawn mower 割草机为固定搭配。lawn tennis 草地网球为网球旧称，阅读偶见。
collocations: mow the lawn 修剪草坪
on the lawn 在草坪上
words.mnemonic: 谐音「廊」→ 屋廊前的草坪；yawn 打哈欠勿混

words.definition: n. 自助餐厅，食堂

examples.en: Students complain that the cafeteria food is dull and overpriced.
examples.zh: 学生们抱怨食堂饭菜单调又贵。

examples.en: The hospital cafeteria stays open around the clock for night staff.
examples.zh: 医院食堂昼夜开放，方便夜班员工。

words.usage: 可数名词，核心特征是 self-service 自助取餐；学校、公司食堂美式称 cafeteria，英式多说 canteen。由西班牙语「咖啡店」借入，可联想 cafe 记忆。
collocations: eat in the cafeteria 在食堂用餐
words.mnemonic: cafe+teria → 自助式咖啡馆 → 食堂；对 bacteria

words.definition: n. 宫殿；豪华宅邸

examples.en: The former royal palace now houses a history museum.
examples.zh: 昔日的王宫如今是一座历史博物馆。

examples.en: Tourists gather outside the palace to watch the changing of the guard.
examples.zh: 游客聚在宫外观看卫兵换岗。

words.usage: 可数名词，宫殿；palace coup 宫廷政变为新闻高频；Buckingham Palace 白金汉宫。派生：palatial adj. 宏伟如宫殿的，阅读词汇；亦可谑称豪华大厦。
words.mnemonic: pal(友)+ace(王牌) → 伙伴的顶级宅 → 宫殿

words.definition: n. 架子，搁板

examples.en: The reference books are kept on the top shelf of the library.
examples.zh: 工具书放在图书馆的顶层架子上。

examples.en: These products have a shelf life of only two weeks.
examples.zh: 这些产品的保质期只有两周。

words.usage: 可数名词，复数 shelves，f 变 v 加 es，同 knife、wife 规则；on the shelf 喻「束之高阁、滞销」；shelf life 保质期为生活经济类高频词。
words.mnemonic: shelf → shelves：f 变 v，knife 同款变化

words.definition: n. 剃刀，刮胡刀；vt. 剃

examples.en: He cut himself with a dull razor while shaving.
examples.zh: 刮脸时他被钝剃刀割伤了。

examples.en: The bill passed by a razor-thin margin of two votes.
examples.zh: 该法案以两票的微弱优势获得通过。

words.usage: razor-thin 极微弱的，修饰 margin、majority，选举报道高频：win by a razor-thin margin 以极微弱优势获胜。派生：razor-sharp adj. 极锋利的、敏锐的。
words.mnemonic: raze(剃平→夷平)+or → 剃平胡子的工具 → 剃刀

words.definition: n. 氢

examples.en: Hydrogen fuel cells produce electricity with zero emissions.
examples.zh: 氢燃料电池发电零排放。

examples.en: Water can be split into hydrogen and oxygen by electrolysis.
examples.zh: 水可通过电解分解为氢和氧。

words.usage: 化学元素不可数名词，符号 H；hydrogen bomb 氢弹、hydrogen fuel cell 氢燃料电池为科技阅读高频。词根 hydro 表水，可联想 hydroelectric 水电的。
collocations: hydrogen fuel cell 氢燃料电池
words.mnemonic: hydro(水)+gen(生成) → 生成水之气 → 氢

words.definition: n. 陶器（总称）；制陶术；陶器厂

examples.en: Fragments of ancient pottery reveal the village's trading history.
examples.zh: 古陶器残片揭示了这座村落的贸易史。

examples.en: She enrolled in a pottery course and made her first bowl.
examples.zh: 她报了陶艺班，做了自己的第一只碗。

words.usage: 不可数名词，陶器、陶艺总称，亦可指陶器厂；考古文本常见 pottery shards 陶片。派生：potter n. 陶工；potter around 悠闲地做琐事。
words.mnemonic: pot(罐)+tery → 制罐手艺 → 陶艺；poetry 是诗

words.definition: n. 休息厅，休息室；vi. （懒洋洋地）倚，躺

examples.en: Passengers waited in the departure lounge for the delayed flight.
examples.zh: 乘客在候机厅等候延误的航班。

examples.en: He lounged on the sofa all afternoon, avoiding his essay.
examples.zh: 他整个下午都瘫在沙发上，拖着不写论文。

words.usage: 名词休息厅，departure lounge 候机厅为旅行场景高频；动词 lounge around 懒散闲待，带慵懒意味。美式 lounge 亦指机场贵宾室与酒店酒吧。
words.mnemonic: 似 long 躺 → 拉长身子懒躺；lunge 才是突刺

words.definition: n. 钙

examples.en: Milk and cheese are rich in calcium and vitamin D.
examples.zh: 牛奶和奶酪富含钙和维生素D。

examples.en: Calcium carbonate is the main component of limestone and shells.
examples.zh: 碳酸钙是石灰石和贝壳的主要成分。

words.usage: 化学元素不可数名词，符号 Ca；健康阅读高频：calcium carbonate 碳酸钙、calcium supplement 钙剂。词根 calc 石灰，联想 calculus 微积分同根。
words.mnemonic: calc(石灰)+ium(元素后缀) → 钙；calculus 微积分

words.definition: n. 咳嗽；vi. 咳，咳嗽

examples.en: The doctor prescribed syrup for his dry cough.
examples.zh: 医生给他开了治干咳的糖浆。

examples.en: She had a bad cough and could hardly speak during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她咳得厉害，开会时几乎说不出话。

words.usage: 名词与动词同形，have a bad cough 咳得厉害；短语 cough up 咳出，俚语引申「被迫交出钱或信息」。拼写注意 ou 发短音、gh 发 f 音。
collocations: have a bad cough 咳得厉害
words.mnemonic: c+ough：gh 读 f；ough 家族还有 rough、tough

words.definition: n. 托盘，盘子

examples.en: The nurse carried a tray of instruments into the ward.
examples.zh: 护士端着一托盘器械走进病房。

examples.en: He balanced a tray of drinks and made his way to the table.
examples.zh: 他端稳一托盘饮料，走向那张桌子。

words.usage: 可数名词，托盘、浅盘，a tray of drinks 一托盘饮料；机场安检盘、医院器械盘皆用 tray。近形词 trait 特质、trail 小径，阅读须凭上下文分辨。
collocations: a tray of drinks 一托盘饮料
words.mnemonic: tray 平盘端物；trait 特质、trail 小径勿混

words.definition: n. 水坝，堤；vt. 筑坝拦（水）；抑制

examples.en: The new dam will supply electricity to three provinces.
examples.zh: 新大坝将为三个省供电。

examples.en: Environmentalists argued that the dam would destroy the wetlands.
examples.zh: 环保人士认为大坝将毁掉那片湿地。

words.usage: 名词水坝；动词 dam up 筑坝拦水，引申「压抑情感、泪水」，如 dam up one's feelings；hydroelectric dam 水电站大坝为能源话题高频。
collocations: build a dam 修筑大坝
dam up the river 拦河筑坝
words.mnemonic: dam 坝，damn 诅咒：坝上少一个 n，无人骂

words.definition: n. （动物的）爪子；vi. 用爪扒

examples.en: The dog left muddy paw prints across the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 狗在厨房地板上留下泥爪印。

examples.en: The cat pawed at the door until someone let it in.
examples.zh: 猫用爪子扒门，直到有人放它进去。

words.usage: 名词指带肉垫的兽爪，猫狗用 paw，尖锐钩爪是 claw；动词 paw at sth 用爪扒挠。paw prints 爪印为侦探、动物题材常见词。
collocations: paw at the door 用爪扒门
words.mnemonic: paw 爪、jaw 颚、saw 锯：-aw 一家人
